quote.text: A bad person’s character cannot be trusted, it’s weak and indecisive, easily won over by different impressions at different times.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as a child's character flourishes under consistent guidance, so too does a reliable person; aim to model steadfast virtue and integrity in your actions.
    • Instill in your children the strength of a resolute character, teaching them that wavering commitments can lead to a fragmented self.
  • Leadership
    • A leader must stand as the embodiment of steadfast values, for a character influenced by every breeze of opinion lacks the firmness required to inspire trust.
    • The strength of a leader is measured by the consistency of his decisions and the clarity of his convictions, ensuring his followers are guided by reliable purpose.
  • Product Management
    • In the realm of product management, a clear and unwavering vision is essential; shifting directions too readily can erode trust among teams and customers.
    • Build and nurture products on the foundation of stability and consistent strategy, for like a strong character, a well-grounded product withstands the tests of time and market fluctuations.
